scope: SYRUP timestep sensitivity on one fixed case; finest run is a numerical reference, not truth

ksat_m_per_s.decision: deterministic XML mean; the configured normal draw (std > mean) could be negative and is not sampled. Not a reproduction of a legacy realization.
ksat_m_per_s.used_for: K when local rain is zero; drainage demand

soil_thickness_m.note: soil-water depth only; unrelated to the MAPLE sediment column depth

override.commit_path: sediment_bed.commit_bed: MAPLE evaluate_commit_triggers + commit_topography with the case's avalanching spec and the constant_depth water callback; no scheduler wind tables
override.rule: per-run override of water depth ownership only; the case file is unchanged; MAPLE's stock water adapters are not used and nothing is relabelled as one

syrup.sediment_velocity_memory: explicit recession exp(-dt/tau), tau = -1 s / ln 0.9, uncapped
syrup.time_levels: post-route consistent depth and velocity; rain rate of the step
syrup.transaction: two MAPLE water calls per accepted step: pickup, then transport, then deposit/export
syrup.travel_distance_policy: local hydraulics (deposition rate 1/L from the current cell's law)

timing_note: consult acceptance record for concurrent-run status; refinement timings are not a controlled speed comparison
